messages:
Ava P: Heads up — two customers opened bugs after upgrading to 0.12.3. Stack traces are all pointing to minimized lines — sourcemaps not shipped. Also Edge imports fail in one case (Cannot find module '.../dist/index.mjs').

Diego M: I scanned the publish logs. The bundle step outputs both index.mjs and index.js, but the publish job uses `files` + `.npmignore` which excludes `**/*.map` and `**/*.mjs` (someone tried to shrink the package last month).

Ava P: Oof. Any quick workaround for Edge users?

Nora L: Two options: 1) republish with maps and mjs included (preferred), 2) change package.json exports to point `import` -> `./dist/index.js` temporarily (works but suboptimal for strict ESM runtimes).

build-bot: publish log snippet: `tarball created: package-0.12.3.tgz (contains dist/index.js, dist/index.cjs, dist/index.d.ts) - skipping dist/index.mjs dist/index.js.map`

Diego M: The root cause is `.npmignore` entry added in https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/commit/def3a12 which had `dist/**/*.mjs` and `dist/**/*.map` to reduce pack size for internal staging. That commit slipped into the release branch.

Ava P: Can we push a patch release quickly? Customers in prod are seeing poor debuggability.

Nora L: I'll open a revert PR to restore `.mjs` and `.map` inclusion and cut 0.12.4. Also adding a CI pack-verify job: after build run `npm pack --dry-run` and assert expected files exist. Example snippet: 
```sh
npm pack --dry-run > /tmp/pack.txt
for f in dist/index.mjs dist/index.js.map dist/index.d.ts; do
  grep -q "$f" /tmp/pack.txt || (echo "MISSING: $f" && exit 1)
done
```

Diego M: Also add a smoke test that installs the tarball and runs both `node -e "require('./').version"` and an ESM import test via `node --input-type=module -e "import pkg from './'; console.log(typeof pkg)"` against the packed files. That will catch mismatched exports.

Ava P: Good. Any typing fallout? A support ticket mentioned `index.d.ts` missing for yarn 1 installs.

build-bot: CI artifact list: dist/index.d.ts present in build output, but `npm pack` output omitted it because `.npmignore` had an override. So types existed but were excluded from published package.

Nora L: We'll also add a package.json lint step to ensure `exports` paths are present in `files` globs. Small node script idea: read package.json, for each export path check it exists in build output. If mismatch, fail CI.

cli-bot: Created release candidate 0.12.4-rc.1 with restored files (dry-run). Tarball contents: dist/index.cjs, dist/index.js, dist/index.mjs, dist/index.js.map, dist/index.mjs.map, dist/index.d.ts.

Ava P: Thanks. Can we add a short doc in onboarding checklist: "How to validate SDK publish" with `npm pack --dry-run`, check exports, and run the smoke import tests? New hires keep tripping over this.

Diego M: Agreed. I'll add the checklist to docs/devx/publishing.md and wire the CI script into the release pipeline.

Nora L: One more note — while triaging we noticed subtle auth/retry divergence in ESM vs CJS builds (different transpilation step changed error wrapping). I'll open a small PR to run test matrix for runtime parity across CJS/ESM during CI. Might reveal edge-only auth edgecases.

Ava P: Perfect. Once 0.12.4 is out, I'll reply to the support tickets with the fixed version and a temporary pin suggestion `npm i @redwood/sdk@0.12.2` for those who can't upgrade immediately.

cli-bot: Published 0.12.4. Monitoring user errors for next 48h.

Ava P: Closing the loop here. Thanks all — adding the postmortem and checklist to the devex channel later today :thumbsup:
